summary: A stale WriteOp::Upsert admits an entry already removed from the hash table, leaving an orphan deque node at the LRU front that stops eviction for good, so the cache grows past max_capacity.
future::Cache::and_compute_with removes its per-key waiter before writing to the cache, so a concurrent call on the same key reads the old value and one update is silently lost.
In sync::Cache, when expire_after_update returns None for an entry that has already expired, the expiration is not cleared, so the value just written stays unreadable.
